howtos.title: Have an agent trial a new library in a draft PR
howtos.what: Matt Pocock's prompt of the day: an agent researches the XState v6 beta and proves its value on your hardest problem.
copy: Ask the agent to research the XState v6 beta.
Have it find the gnarliest problem in your app that v6 could help with.
Have it build a proof of concept in a draft PR.
Have it verify the proof of concept.
howtos.whenToUse: When deciding whether a new library or beta release is worth adopting in your codebase.

howtos.title: Run coding agents locally, execute code in a sandbox
howtos.what: Simon Willison's 'external sandbox' pattern: the agent stays on your Mac, but the code it runs is isolated.
copy: Run the coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) on your Mac.
Have it execute code in an external sandbox: WebAssembly, QEMU or Apple Container.
howtos.whenToUse: When you want coding agents to run code without access to your whole machine.
